caption:
Grad school just got more complicated to pay for. 🎓

AP reports new federal loan caps are pushing many borrowers toward private lenders. Graduate programs are capped at $100,000, and professional degrees at $200,000.

SoFi said its student loan originations hit $2.9 billion last quarter, nearly double a year earlier.

If you borrowed for school, what do you wish you'd known first?
